verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own docs say its tokenization feature enables cards in Apple Pay, Google Pay and other digital wallets for Visa and Mastercard credit, debit and prepaid cards. So the core outcome of cards landing in wallets is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence describes how that happens: there is no mention of in-app push provisioning, the Apple/Google entitlements process, in-wallet card art, or a manual provisioning fallback. The card design guide covers physical card production, not wallet art. missing for 10: in-app push provisioning SDK/API docs, documented entitlements process, in-wallet card art configuration, manual provisioning fallback, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, cards land in Apple Pay and Google Pay — push provisioning from my app with the entitlements process documented, plus in-wallet card art and manual provisioning as a fallback
